learnability_limitations.outcomes_statement: (1) usefulness: TASK_FEASIBLE (confidence CONFIDENCE_UNRESOLVED, reserve qualified False); (2) gain beyond the mechanism-specific controls: PARTIAL_START_ONLY (D2R ROBUSTNESS_NOT_CONFIRMED; learning curve LEARNABILITY_LIMITATION); (3) strong references: NOT_SUPERIOR (passed ['NEURAL_RAW', 'W', 'TR100', 'TT100'], failed ['B2TWIN', 'H_LJ', 'RETIRED_B3CTL', 'SUCC', 'TWJ']); (4) material target: NOT_MET; (5) joint design: NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_JOINT, novelty: NOT_CLAIMED; the pair benefit changes sign on the robustness cells against RF_STOP_HI, RF_ALTC_HI, SUCC; a single-view recipient condition fails on the robustness cells against RF_RAWJ_HI, H_LJ, RETIRED_B3CTL, SUCC: carried into the headline; the pair benefit against RF_TASK, RF_ALTC_HI, H_LJ is smaller with readers fitted on the full FIT than on its fixed half: a learnability effect is possible; reported as a limitation, never as information removal

summary.statement: D2 was met in 0 of 1 registered readings and in 0 of 1 non-registered readings (2 D2 looks in total); D3 was met in 0 and D4 in 0 of 2 readings; a learnability limitation was carried in 2; one AGG_POSITIVE comparison passes a true null in about 0.07-2% of replicates under six moderate NRM1 known laws and about 8% when one version or split dominates (NRM1 RULES.md 5.5); a D2 look is an intersection-union conjunction of up to five such comparisons (START, CONT, STOPFIT at its bracket, ALTCRIT at its bracket or point unless an exact alias of STOPFIT, RAWJ at its bracket) plus reader targeting, so its false-pass rate is at most that of its weakest member; with K D2 looks the chance that at least one passes by chance is at most K times the per-look rate; no multiplicity correction is applied or claimed.
